4
Kristo Asomafoɔ
1 # Tito 1.7 Momma obiara mmu yɛn sɛ Kristo asomfoɔ ne Nyankopɔn ahuntasɛm so ahwɛfoɔ. 2#Luk 12.42 Na afei, deɛ wɔhwehwɛ firi efiehwɛfoɔ hɔ ne sɛ obiara bɛhunu sɛ ɔyɛ nokwafoɔ. 3Na me deɛ, ɛyɛ me adeɛ ketewa bi sɛ mo anaa nnipa bi hyɛ da bu me atɛn, nso memmu me ho atɛn. 4#Dwom 143.2 Ɛfiri sɛ me deɛ menhunu biribiara wɔ me ho, nanso ɛnyɛ yei ho na medi bem; na deɛ ɔbu me atɛn ne Awurade. 5#1 Ko 3.8 Enti mommpere ho mmmu biribiara ho atɛn kɔsi sɛ ɛberɛ no bɛduru ansa na Awurade bɛba; ɔno na ɔde deɛ ahunta sum mu bɛba hann mu, na wayi akoma mu agyina adi; ɛno ansa na Onyankopɔn de obiara ayeyie bɛma no.
6 # Rom 12.3 Na anuanom, mo nti na mede asɛm yi metoo me ne Apolo ho mekyerɛɛ mo, na moasua yɛn sɛ morennwene ntra deɛ wɔatwerɛ no, na mo mu bi anhoahoa ne ho ne obi anni asie.
7 # Rom 12.6 Na hwan na ɔma wo da nso wɔ afoforɔ mu? Na ɛdeɛn na wowɔ a woannya? Na sɛ wonyae a, adɛn nti na wohoahoa wo ho sɛdeɛ ɛnyɛ nya na wonyaeɛ? 8#Adi 3.17; 3.21 Moawie mee dada, aane moawie mo ho nya, moakwati yɛn adi ahene. Sɛ modii ahene ampa a, anka ɛyɛ, na yɛn nso yɛne mo adi bi. 9#Rom 8.36; Heb 10.33 Na ɛyɛ me sɛ Onyankopɔn de yɛn asomafoɔ adi akyire sɛ wɔn a wɔayi wɔn ama owuo, ɛfiri sɛ yɛayɛ ahwɛdeɛ ama wiase ne abɔfoɔ ne nnipa. 10#1 Ko 3.18 Kristo nti yɛyɛ nkwaseafoɔ, na mo deɛ, moyɛ anyansafoɔ, Kristo mu; yɛyɛ mmerɛ, na mo deɛ, mo ho yɛ den. Mo deɛ, moyɛ animuonyamfoɔ, na yɛn deɛ yɛyɛ ahohorafoɔ. 11#2 Ko 11.23-27 Ɛde bɛsi dɔn yi mu, ɛkɔm ne sukɔm de yɛn, na yɛda adagya, na wɔhwe yɛn, na yɛnni baabi te, 12#Aso 18.3; 20.34; 1 Te 2.9; 2 Te 3.8; 1 Ko 9.15; Rom 12.14; Dwom 109.28 na yɛbrɛ de yɛn ara yɛn nsa yɛ adwuma. Wɔya yɛn a, yɛhyira, wɔtaa yɛn a, yɛpene so, 13wɔsɛe yɛn din a, yɛka abodwosɛm. Yɛayɛ sɛ wiase fi, nnipa nyinaa mu sumina de bɛsi nnɛ.
Agya afotuo
14Mentwerɛ yei memmɛgu mo anim ase, na mmom mede rebɛtu mo fo sɛ me mma adɔfo. 15#Gal 4.19 Na sɛ mowɔ ahwɛfoɔ ɔpedu wɔ Kristo mu mpo a, monni agyanom bebree; na me na menam asɛmpa no so mewoo mo Kristo Yesu mu. 16#1 Ko 11.1 Enti metu mo fo sɛ: Monhwɛ me nsua me. 17#Aso 19.22 Yei nti na masoma Timoteo a ɔyɛ me ba dɔfo ne nokwafoɔ Awurade mu aba mo nkyɛn; ɔno na ɔbɛkae mo m’akwan a ɛwɔ Kristo Yesu mu sɛdeɛ mekyerɛkyerɛ asafo nyinaa mu wɔ mmaa nyinaa.
18Na ebinom rehoahoa wɔn ho sɛdeɛ meremma mo nkyɛn. 19#Aso 18.21; Yak 4.15 Nso sɛ Awurade pɛ a, ɛrenkyɛ na maba mo nkyɛn, na mabɛhunu wɔn a wɔrehoahoa wɔn ho no tumi, na ɛnyɛ wɔn nsɛm a. 20#1 Ko 2.4; Luk 17.20 Na Onyankopɔn ahennie nni kasa ara kɛkɛ mu, na mmom tumi mu. 21Deɛ ɛwɔ he na mopɛ? Memfa abaa mmra mo so, anaa ɔdɔ ne ɔdwoɔ honhom?

pageProps.chapterText:
Momma obiara mmu yɛn sɛ Kristo asomfoɔ ne Nyankopɔn ahuntasɛm so ahwɛfoɔ. Na afei, deɛ wɔhwehwɛ firi efiehwɛfoɔ hɔ ne sɛ obiara bɛhunu sɛ ɔyɛ nokwafoɔ. Na me deɛ, ɛyɛ me adeɛ ketewa bi sɛ mo anaa nnipa bi hyɛ da bu me atɛn, nso memmu me ho atɛn. Ɛfiri sɛ me deɛ menhunu biribiara wɔ me ho, nanso ɛnyɛ yei ho na medi bem; na deɛ ɔbu me atɛn ne Awurade. Enti mommpere ho mmmu biribiara ho atɛn kɔsi sɛ ɛberɛ no bɛduru ansa na Awurade bɛba; ɔno na ɔde deɛ ahunta sum mu bɛba hann mu, na wayi akoma mu agyina adi; ɛno ansa na Onyankopɔn de obiara ayeyie bɛma no.
Na anuanom, mo nti na mede asɛm yi metoo me ne Apolo ho mekyerɛɛ mo, na moasua yɛn sɛ morennwene ntra deɛ wɔatwerɛ no, na mo mu bi anhoahoa ne ho ne obi anni asie.
Na hwan na ɔma wo da nso wɔ afoforɔ mu? Na ɛdeɛn na wowɔ a woannya? Na sɛ wonyae a, adɛn nti na wohoahoa wo ho sɛdeɛ ɛnyɛ nya na wonyaeɛ? Moawie mee dada, aane moawie mo ho nya, moakwati yɛn adi ahene. Sɛ modii ahene ampa a, anka ɛyɛ, na yɛn nso yɛne mo adi bi. Na ɛyɛ me sɛ Onyankopɔn de yɛn asomafoɔ adi akyire sɛ wɔn a wɔayi wɔn ama owuo, ɛfiri sɛ yɛayɛ ahwɛdeɛ ama wiase ne abɔfoɔ ne nnipa. Kristo nti yɛyɛ nkwaseafoɔ, na mo deɛ, moyɛ anyansafoɔ, Kristo mu; yɛyɛ mmerɛ, na mo deɛ, mo ho yɛ den. Mo deɛ, moyɛ animuonyamfoɔ, na yɛn deɛ yɛyɛ ahohorafoɔ. Ɛde bɛsi dɔn yi mu, ɛkɔm ne sukɔm de yɛn, na yɛda adagya, na wɔhwe yɛn, na yɛnni baabi te, na yɛbrɛ de yɛn ara yɛn nsa yɛ adwuma. Wɔya yɛn a, yɛhyira, wɔtaa yɛn a, yɛpene so, wɔsɛe yɛn din a, yɛka abodwosɛm. Yɛayɛ sɛ wiase fi, nnipa nyinaa mu sumina de bɛsi nnɛ.

Mentwerɛ yei memmɛgu mo anim ase, na mmom mede rebɛtu mo fo sɛ me mma adɔfo. Na sɛ mowɔ ahwɛfoɔ ɔpedu wɔ Kristo mu mpo a, monni agyanom bebree; na me na menam asɛmpa no so mewoo mo Kristo Yesu mu. Enti metu mo fo sɛ: Monhwɛ me nsua me. Yei nti na masoma Timoteo a ɔyɛ me ba dɔfo ne nokwafoɔ Awurade mu aba mo nkyɛn; ɔno na ɔbɛkae mo m’akwan a ɛwɔ Kristo Yesu mu sɛdeɛ mekyerɛkyerɛ asafo nyinaa mu wɔ mmaa nyinaa.
Na ebinom rehoahoa wɔn ho sɛdeɛ meremma mo nkyɛn. Nso sɛ Awurade pɛ a, ɛrenkyɛ na maba mo nkyɛn, na mabɛhunu wɔn a wɔrehoahoa wɔn ho no tumi, na ɛnyɛ wɔn nsɛm a. Na Onyankopɔn ahennie nni kasa ara kɛkɛ mu, na mmom tumi mu. Deɛ ɛwɔ he na mopɛ? Memfa abaa mmra mo so, anaa ɔdɔ ne ɔdwoɔ honhom?

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
